# Phil Gordon & Shirley

- [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) — Friend of — [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) — close friends reunited at Green Gables · since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves Patty's Place to walk in the park on a rainy November afternoon. When her umbrella breaks in the storm, she is rescued by Royal Gardner, a handsome student who perfectly matches her ideal hero. After returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a delivery of roses from [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), sparking talk of romance among her housemates.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXV Enter Prince Charming

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P27](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0027), [v3 ch.Charming P29](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0029), [v3 ch.Charming P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), [v3 ch.Charming P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her wedding plans and guest list with Mrs. Lynde and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). In the following days, guests arrive to celebrate, including Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta the Fourth, and [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), who presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with Miss Patty's china dogs. On the eve of her wedding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Matthew's grave before joining [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) on a walk home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG
